goal: Collapse the admin-invite onboarding journey into the existing self-serve funnel: the admin enters only owner email, owner name and business name, and the invited owner walks set password → place capture → AI demo → real Stripe Checkout with an auto-applied 100%-off 3-month beta coupon snapshotted onto the checkout attempt → wizard → dashboard, with SELF_SERVE_SIGNUP_ENABLED re-scoped to gate only anonymous account-minting and one server-side resolveFunnelEntry owning every funnel destination.
non_goals: No changes to the self-serve signup surfaces themselves (/signup, OTP verification, Google OAuth finish) beyond the flag re-scope
No changes to demo-lane mechanics, cost-guard, wizard steps, Zernio connect, or the import-offer flow
No per-account comp flag or concierge-paid invite support
No admin 'activate' button or any non-Stripe status-writing path
No post-activation display_name rename sync and no change to the /api/settings editable-field asymmetry
No changes to multi-location, offboarding, or solicitation flows
No creation of the Stripe coupon, no env-var value setting, no flag-value changes, no Railway/Vercel/Supabase remote mutations (ops steps, reported not performed)
user_visible_behavior: Admin /admin/businesses/new shows exactly three inputs: owner email, owner name, business name
An invited owner who sets their password is returned to /login and, after login, lands on the funnel step their state implies rather than always /onboarding/pay
An invited owner reaches the AI demo lane (place capture → demo) exactly like a self-serve signup
An invited owner's Stripe Checkout shows $0 due today when BETA_COMP_COUPON_ID is configured, and still collects a card
The dead-end admin-handoff screen is gone: admin-invited pending_payment owners see the standard PendingPaymentScreen whose CTA points at their funnel step
/login, /forgot-password and /reset-password are reachable regardless of SELF_SERVE_SIGNUP_ENABLED, so an invited beta owner can recover their password
An admin can resend an invite from /admin/businesses/[id] when the owner has never signed in
invariants: Invariant 3 — no unapproved posting: unchanged; this feature touches no publishing path

Invariant 9 — accounts row is the billing parent; businesses row is a location; coupon eligibility reads onboarded_by from the PRIMARY business (b.is_primary = TRUE) so a multi-location account cannot resolve it from an arbitrary row
Invariant 11 — Stripe is the source of truth: activation happens only through apply-subscription-state.ts driven by a real Checkout Session; no code path writes subscription_status directly
Invariant 13 — feature flags are server-authoritative: the funnel destination is computed server-side and returned as funnelUrl; no NEXT_PUBLIC_ flag companion is added

Invariant 15 — domain modules receive their DB client as an explicit parameter: resolveFunnelEntry and the resend-invite mapping module take sql/supabase as parameters and never import @/lib/db/server

Checkout-attempt immutability: every Stripe Session parameter, including the coupon, comes from the durable checkout_attempt_* snapshot resolved under the activation lock — never from a live env read at session-creation time
accounts_checkout_attempt_complete_check null-at-rest branch enumerates EVERY attempt column, so a cleared attempt cannot retain a coupon snapshot
Tenant isolation: every new query is scoped by account_id and, per-location, business_id
Every route that loses its SELF_SERVE_SIGNUP_ENABLED gate enforces authenticated session + role='owner' + the route's own allowed subscription-state set
edge_cases: Coupon env var unset at attempt creation → NULL persisted as an explicit no-coupon decision; a later env flip must not change that attempt's Stripe params under the same idempotency key
Coupon env var unset after an attempt was snapshotted with a coupon → the attempt keeps its coupon (idempotency contract, not a bug)
Multi-location account: onboarded_by must be read from the primary business, not an arbitrary joined row
100%-off session must still collect a card — payment_method_collection:'always' set explicitly, not relying on Stripe's subscription-mode default
Wrong/invalid coupon ID → Stripe rejects session creation; must surface a clear message plus a Sentry report, not a generic checkout failure
Owner in pending_payment with demo enabled and no place → /onboarding/start; with a place already captured → /onboarding/demo (drop-off return point)
Owner in pending_payment with demo disabled → /onboarding/pay
Owner post-payment with wizard incomplete → /onboarding/business; wizard complete → /dashboard
/onboarding/payment-success and GET /api/auth/signup-status stay reachable across the Stripe-projection transition (pending_payment AND post-payment) so polling cannot 403 mid-transition
/onboarding/pay's page query currently has no u.role = 'owner' filter — it gains one
GET /api/signup/place-prefill is a GET (not POST); anonymous GET must be rejected while keeping the strict per-IP limit and adding a per-auth-id limit
POST /api/auth/reset-password deliberately signs out the recovery session after the password write — preserve that; redirectTo stays /login
Resend-invite eligibility must use the provider's last_sign_in_at (users.auth_id is patched at creation, before acceptance, so it proves nothing)
Resend-invite provider error of unknown shape → 502 with the raw code logged; never an automatic retry
Owner renames the business during onboarding while accounts.display_name holds the admin-typed name → display_name must re-sync during pending_payment, not only when it equals the placeholder
Existing stuck admin-onboarded pending_payment accounts already have place/voice populated — the wizard guard must route them past steps they do not need

rollback_plan: Migration 105 is additive (nullable column) plus a CHECK rewrite. Back out by re-applying 077's constraint definition verbatim and dropping accounts.checkout_attempt_coupon_id in a follow-up migration; no data loss since the column is nullable and no attempt is created from it before the coupon feature is used. Runtime kill switch: leave BETA_COMP_COUPON_ID unset — every new attempt then snapshots NULL and the Stripe session carries no discount. Revert order for the code: revert the PR (single branch), then the migration only if the column must go. Prod is additionally gated by the WS8 cutover — 077/078 are deliberately absent in prod, so 105 must not be applied there before the cutover.
observability: Structured worker/server log line on every checkout-session creation recording coupon applied vs skipped and the skip reason (not_invited / env_unset)
Durable PostHog analytics event coupon_decision inserted server-side with the same fields, so silent non-application is visible before a beta tester is charged
Stripe invalid-coupon errors mapped to a named error and reported to Sentry via reportCaughtError rather than a generic checkout failure
Existing admin-onboarding error logs (redacted email) continue to cover invite/resend failures
